d97 say: ◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Nora — 16 days worked on the land. It offers Stalk. Earned, not given. (stalk: villager System grant)
d97 say: ◈ The realm came apart — no polity answers to Haven now, and Haven is a free fire again. National no longer describe this village. The climb starts over.

d97 say: ◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are wa
d97 say: 🌟 "We have stopped arguing with you." A pause. "Do not mistake this for agreement."
d97 say: The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.
d97 say: Nora came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
d97 say: Word gets around the haven. Whatever that thing was — everyone's talking about it now.
d97 say: Back at the haven the argument starts: Nora is calling it "Ugly-Eyes." They'll fight it out — weigh in if you want.
d97 say: Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
d97 say: ⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
d97 say: Village meal: +2367 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
d97 say: Nora traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
d97 say: 🌿 Elderberry — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
d97 say: 💡 Elderberry: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.

d97 say: 🌙 Raid — The Hungry Road came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~300 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
d98 say: — DAY 98 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
d98 say: Overnight, White Oak Acorns (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
d98 say: Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.

d92 say: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Wei blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d92 say: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"

d97 say: Travel 3 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Fallen trunks lie like sleeping animals, furred with moss. The ground gives underfoot — centuries of leaf-mold.
d97 say: Something moves out there — Buffering.
d97 say: Movement — a bobcat, tufted ears, watching you with yellow eyes.
d97 say: 👁 It is hunting you. Don't run — that invites the chase. Hold your ground, strike true, or wear the claws.
d97 say: Journal: Deep shade. The floor keeps its secrets.
d97 say: ✨ SYNERGY DISCOVERED: Sun Eater's Garden!
d97 say: The plants feed you. You feed the plants. The System is confused and delighted.
d97 say: 📺 SYSTEM: ""WAIT. You grow the food AND you eat the sun?! That's... that's double-dipping! The gamblers are FURIOUS they didn't think of it! The plants like you AND you ARE a plant?!""
d97 say: ⚡ SYNERGY WITNESSED: Sun Eater's Garden! (Recorded in your Codex.)
d97 say: You work the patch with practiced hands: 12× White Oak Acorns (in shell — shell them to eat). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
d97 say: Travel 2 tiles to Haven.
d97 say: The Buffering stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
d97 say: You keep a day's food (1800 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
d97 say: 1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
d97 say: You walk back into Haven. 43 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
d97 say: 📋 Nora — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
d97 say: Taken: Wildmark Wraps x1, Snare wire x1.
